filed: 2026-11-11, before run.py ran; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)
descriptive: user, 2026-11-11, ask 17: the plain overlap is a descriptive baseline; no verdict on reuse, sides named as built
seen_before_filing: E143's top-set swap on these pairs and rows (experiments/holes_fill/results/stage1.json: inert, every |share| under 0.05 of the gain at k 64 and k matched); E52's idle share on copy vs random maps (copy 0.41, cipher 0.125, experiments/baseline_neurons). No overlap reading of any state.

definitions.firing: each block's MLP neurons (GELU output = down_proj's input, steering.Net site mlp<l>), fp32 target model, on the read rows of E136's inventory (the rows the share and E143 read), at the read position only
definitions.overlap: per block and read row, |A0 & A1| / |A0 | A1|, A0 and A1 the 240 neurons of largest |firing| at W0 and at W0 + the saved update (masked_reads.top_overlap); mean over rows, then over the 4 blocks
definitions.on_both: sum over rows and blocks of (firing change)^2 on neurons in both top-240 sets, over the same sum on every neuron; nan when the denominator is 0 (no firing changed)
definitions.k 64: the same two numbers with 64-neuron sets, recorded as a second form, not called
definitions.random update: per side, a Gaussian matrix per weight matrix scaled to the Frobenius norm of the side's first seed's update in that matrix (all 24 matrices), torch generator seed random_seed + 1 + its index in run.firsts(); one per side, a side shared by two pairs read once
definitions.pair rule: rules.call on each reading at k 240: gap = mean(reuse side) - mean(new side) over saved seeds; band = the larger within-side max - min, measured on this job's stage 1 readings (no number set in advance); 'reuse side higher' iff gap > band, 'new side higher' iff -gap > band (both strict), 'no call' otherwise; 'unreadable' iff fewer than 2 seeds on a side or a nan. On the overlap reading, 'reuse side higher' reads 'the reuse side overlaps more'
definitions.floor: rules.floor per side: the side's mean minus its random update's reading; reported beside the call, not part of it
definitions.why it might read the other way: E52's idle share on copy vs random maps was reversed: of each fine-tune's 16 most-shifted neurons, those quiet at W0 were 0.41 on copy against 0.125 on cipher, so copy moved neurons that were not firing before; if that holds at the read position, copy's top set changes more and the copy side overlaps less

edge_cases_checked_before_filing.tie: gap equal to the band (including 0 = 0) is 'no call' (tests/test_neuron_overlap_rules.py)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.gap below zero: 'new side higher' when -gap > band; never folded into the reuse call
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.one seed: fewer than 2 values on a side: 'unreadable' (no band can be measured)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.do-nothing state: every state at W0 reads overlap 1.0 on both sides: gap 0, band 0, 'no call'; on_both is nan: 'unreadable'
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.nan: any nan value on a side (on_both of a state whose update changes no firing): 'unreadable' for that reading only
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.tied |firing| in a top set: torch.topk on the same tensor returns the same indices, so W0 against W0 reads exactly 1.0 (the control); ties among different tensors are not resolved specially, as k 240 sits far above the zero-firing tail

control.order: stage 0 runs first and alone, on the reference state's read rows; a miss stops the job (exit 1) before any state is read
control.zero update: W0 against W0 + a zero update: overlap exactly 1.0, every block's smallest per-row Jaccard exactly 1.0, and on_both nan, at k 240 and k 64
control.positive control: a hand-built 'same neurons, harder' update: each block's c_fc scaled by 1 + d_l, d_l = |dW_l| / |W0_l| (Frobenius) from the reference state's c_fc update, every other matrix 0; against a random update of the same per-matrix norms (seed random_seed). Expected: the scaled update's overlap and on_both above the random one's at k 240 (rules.positive_control, strict). Recorded in stage0.json, not a stop: a miss means the overlap cannot tell 'the same neurons, harder' from a change in no particular direction, and the paragraph says so before any pair is read
control.E52 states: E52's copy vs random maps states are saved and are the pair e46_copy_random here; E52's reading of them is reversed, so they are a cross-check, not a known-answer control

expected.do-nothing reference: the same as W0: no call on every pair
expected.random update: lean: a random update of matched Frobenius norm moves the firing at a given input less than a fine-tune's update, whose few directions line up with the activations, so its overlap is higher than both sides' on most pairs (it is the cell's 'floor' in name; the plan says it may read as a ceiling)
expected.real states: no number filed: the reading is descriptive (card)

P1.claim: the random update of each side reads a higher overlap at k 240 than that side's mean, on at least 10 of the 14 pair-sides
P1.rule: count over pairs and sides of score[pair].overlap.floor[side].above < 0, at least 10 of 14
P1.why: Frobenius-matched random matrices spread their size over every direction; a fine-tune's update concentrates it on the directions the task's activations use

P2.claim: on copy vs random maps the overlap call is not 'reuse side higher'
P2.why: E52's idle share on these states was reversed (copy moved more neurons that were quiet at W0)
